Keep weight streams on die. Other TP degrees and ROM cluster geometry need new routing and exact-reduction prices.

stage_link.formula_cycles: 12 + (ceil(payload_B/64)-1) + board_vendor_cycles + ucie_vendor_cycles + ceil(source_route_um/504) + ceil(destination_route_um/504); 12 endpoint cycles inferred from 652-(641-1), match old full-packet baseline only
stage_link.qualification: Cycle-exact synthetic packet fixture plus assumed/vendor PHY and geometric routed-reach budgets; baseline fails SS setup. Not an integrated SS/FF-qualified link.

credits.fullrate_credit_loop_formula: 2*CHANNEL_CYCLES + 10 baseline; +1 for proposed registered repair; add actual extra route/CDC feedback cycles if not represented by channel
credits.reverse_transport_warning: Bench assumes independently available reverse ACK/NAK/credit lane at one frame/cycle. Real framing and bandwidth must be reserved.
credits.buffer_ports: Replay and receive each 1R1W; payload+last only, extra metadata/register stages separate

collective_conventions.all_gather_payload: Total gathered bytes; per-rank flits ceil(total_bytes/(TP*64)).
collective_conventions.all_reduce_payload: 20480B FP32 contribution per rank for 5120 elements; do NOT divide by TP. Output conversion only after prescribed reduction.
collective_conventions.fixture_endpoint: Issue to last VM commit at slowest rank, behavioural always-ready VM; local 13 cycles at 0.9GHz lane-group write service remains extra if binding same VM path
collective_conventions.tp4_gather_fit_cycles: 263.15 + 1.1204*ceil(payload_B/(4*64)) for measured old geometry; interpolate within fixture only

route.floorplan_rule: New hub/PHY placement recomputes length and tracks; no reuse of old wire stages as a new physical result.

physical.note: PHY footprint must come from selected floorplan contract; no extrapolation of whole old die PHY area to new endpoint count. Historical port_board route also failed; prelayout area is not closure.

hbm_switch_alternative.qualification: Vendor crossing + measured HA2 reducer + assumed efficiency/tail; not substitute for measured TP4 direct links; scale-up switch area/power outside logic die must be included.

power_transport.note: Source technology.json proxies. Avoid double-counting lane always-on energy and active-bit energy; separate power states and include idle/wake policy.
